title: End-to-End neo-fm-web Integration — Ollama LLM Backend

llm_backend_changes.model_name_parameter: Added to LlamaCppBackend constructor — required by Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
llm_backend_changes._http_request_body: New helper method: builds request body including 'model' field for all HTTP requests
llm_backend_changes._http_stream: Updated to skip delta.reasoning tokens from nemotron-3-super reasoning phase; yields only delta.content
llm_backend_changes.OLLAMA_MODEL_NAME: Exported from engine.py as 'nemotron-3-super:120b'; imported in api/main.py

note: nemotron-3-super:120b has a reasoning phase (outputs delta.reasoning before delta.content). _http_stream correctly filters reasoning tokens. Full 120B generation test skipped in automated suite due to ~60s reasoning latency — TTFT gate (< 30s first content token) validated manually.
